title: Your Last Day in Tanzania Before the Flight Home
excerpt: Your flight home leaves in the evening. How to spend your last day in Tanzania well.
body:
## Day room

Many lodges offer a day room for a shower before your flight.

## Options in Arusha

- [Arusha National Park](/blog/arusha-national-park-guide/).
- A coffee farm.
- Shopping for [souvenirs](/blog/tanzania-souvenirs/).

## Options on Zanzibar

- A last swim.
- Stone Town.
- A spice tour.

## Time

Be at the airport about three hours before an international flight.

## Packing

Pack the day before. Check liquids and remove plastic bags.

[Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
